content: The above process has two drawbacks. First, the LM is fixed after fitting to the task data. In the subsequent phase of training the target model, the LM augments data without knowing the state of the target model, which can lead to sub-optimal results. Second, in the cases where the task dataset is small, the LM can be insufficiently trained for preserving the labels faithfully, resulting in noisy augmented samples.
